snapshot.reason: The company is divesting multiple overseas subsidiaries and major assets, including the Essar Wildcat rig, which should significantly improve liquidity and simplify the balance sheet.
snapshot.why_now: The exchange filing detailing these specific asset sales and disinvestments was released on October 3, 2024.
source_headlines: Essar Shipping Limited: Essar Shipping Limited has informed the Exchange about Disinvestment in Essar Shipping DMCC, U.A.E., overseas Whollyowned Subsidiary, Under Section 180(1)(a) of the Companies Act, 2013; Disinvestment in OGD Services Holdings Limited, Mauritius, overseas Whollyowned Subsidiary Under Section 180(1)(a) of the Companies Act, 2013; Sale of Asset - Semisubmersible Rig Essar Wildcat owned by Essar Shipping DMCC, U.A.E., (Whollyowned Subsidiary); Sale of Asset - Tug III, owned by
